notes.title: 🚀 Prospector: The First Contract is out for FREE! 🚀
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Automation Enthusiasts![/h3]

We're excited to announce that our solo-dev friend from Loonworks games has just released a free prologue to his game called Prospector.  "The First Contract" is officially here for you to start your journey with the very first contract you receive as a space-age Prospector! 

[previewyoutube=ENccE9ntTnI;full][/previewyoutube]

In this prologue, you'll land on an unknown planet. Your mission? Build a space outpost, survive the oxygen-less environment, and explore a mysterious alien world.

Assemble robots to automate your base, gather resources, and send them to distant colonies for exclusive rewards!

And don’t worry about feeling lonely. Your loyal robot companion, O.P.H.E.L.I.A, will not only assist with your daily tasks but also protect you from dangers.

Remember, this game is developed by a solo developer, and your feedback and support are truly invaluable! Join his Discord server to share your thoughts and suggestions. The dev is eager to hear your ideas and implement them into the world of Prospector!

So, don't wait any longer! Try this free prologue and start your adventure today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730640/Prospector_The_First_Contract/

[url=https://discord.gg/7awHSQPbN5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d8f0a5bd506f95a4535d2a8875e79873e4201af4.png[/img][/url]

Ed, Doug, and Lucas

notes.title: Devlog #8: Exciting Upgrades Coming to Nova Lands Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for being awesome supporters of Nova Lands! We're working hard on some fantastic new stuff, and we can't wait to show you what's in store. 

Here's a quick rundown:

[b]Meet the Magnetoids![/b]

The biggest addition to the logistics since the launch of the game! They will become your new automation champs, zipping items lightning-fast between buildings. Talk about efficiency!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d76ceb80cb5b118a90b6a873f05b518f23559758.gif[/img]

[b]Advanced Construction Awaits![/b]

Introducing the [b]Particle Accelerator[/b] - the most advanced building yet. It churns out top-tier items you'll need in the late game 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/991850d829113463c580439099e9d98701f70713.png[/img]

[b]What’s Happening at the Space Station?[/b]

Well, say hi to The Inventor. He’s got a drawer with all the cable types in the galaxy and can crack encrypted hard drives while cooking up special production boosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/29e01f64c85e15b08efa157bf00c8f5cb4386ec5.png[/img]

Also, check out the Grappling Hook! It's your go-to tool for spacewalk missions, letting you zip around asteroids like a pro.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/fd0abca2fb26d3cb98a2e240e149a0f260f37d4d.png[/img]

That’s all for now, folks! 
We will share with you the release date of this update quite soon 🙂

Stay in the Loop!

For more Nova Lands updates, follow us on our Steam page and hang out with us on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/EAgPVJNsdZ]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NovaLandsGame/]Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BEHEMUTT]Twitter[/url]
[/list]
Thanks for being part of our Nova Lands community ♥️
See you in Nova Lands - adventure awaits!

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #7: More About Upcoming Content Update
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Thank you for your interest and support in Nova Lands! We really appreciate that and now are working hard on the upcoming content expansion. And we have something interesting to share with you! Let’s check it out :)

[h3]New Additions Await![/h3]

In this expansion, we're introducing another two new buildings:

[b]The Driller[/b]: Say goodbye to the laborious task of manually extracting minerals from the soil! The Driller is here to streamline the process and supercharge your resource gathering efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/7c38997805fe8be452077f8f4c8e862e5c3a1b3f.png[/img]

[b]The Teleporter[/b]: Tired of trekking across all the islands? Create teleportation points that allow you to travel swiftly to any location you desire. It's all about simplicity and efficiency :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/4c45b688103698f928ac2c89472175a03a61cc6f.png[/img]

[h3]Customize Your Playstyle[/h3]

We get it, everyone's got their quirks. That's why we're introducing the [b]Item Collector Filter[/b]. It's your ticket to deciding what gets [b]picked up automatically[/b] and what [b]gets left behind[/b]. Your adventure, your rules!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d9fd8cba6752d045762e66d0775f29b0aa71f5c2.png[/img]

[h3]Discover the Unknown[/h3]

While we can't unveil all the secrets just yet, we're thrilled to offer a sneak peek of a brand-new island. Prepare to explore uncharted territories, make new friends, uncover fresh resources, and encounter exotic flora and fauna. The mysteries of this island are waiting to be unveiled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/f679abf66bac198f62c10d9038b4ffd532c52017.png[/img]

Keep your eyes peeled for more updates by following Nova Lands on our Steam page and across our social media channels:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NovaLandsGame/]Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BEHEMUTT]Twitter[/url]
[/list]
Thank you for your attention and have a great day!
See you in Nova Lands :)

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #6: Upcoming Patches & Content Updates
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Since the release, Nova Lands has received [b]a 92% positive score on Steam[/b], with over a thousand reviews! You are really awesome, and we cannot hide our excitement about this.
With your feedback, we are ready to continue our work on making Nova Lands even better!

So, let's see what we are working on right now!

[h3]Performance Improvements and Fixes[/h3]

Our publisher is working on improving the performance of the console versions and we're sending them every report we get from you. We’re aware of the performance issues on consoles and more patches with improvements are coming soon.

[h3]Upcoming Content Update[/h3]

We’re very happy to confirm we’re working on a content update for the game! This update will not only introduce new buildings and advanced tools but also feature new islands and an extra development on the storyline. Our plan is to have enough content so that players that have already finished that game have a good reason to come back.

But of course we couldn’t end without showing anything, so here are some of the [b]new buildings[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/459f844fbce53c7a7b1522522bfe15b828dbc22d.png[/img]

The bigger ones are the Advanced Assembler, Advanced Industrial Refinery, which are more efficient versions of the existing ones. The Buildings Demolisher was a much requested feature, and it’s function is to destroy all the buildings on the island at once while retaining all the recovered items within itself.

And that's all for now! Stay tuned for more news and updates by following Nova Lands' Steam page and our social media channels:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NovaLandsGame/]Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BEHEMUTT]Twitter[/url]
[/list]
Ed, Doug, and Lucas @BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #5: Content updates for your comfort and PAX East 2023
notes.content:
Greetings!

It's been a while since our last update, but we're happy to report that we're hard at work on the game. We've heard your comments about the release date and we promise to reveal it as soon as the game is ready for launch. And by the way, it won't be long now!

In this month's dev log, we're excited to share some of the latest content updates with you. Let's take a closer look!

[h3][b]Space Station[/b][/h3]

At the Space Station, you’ll find a spot where it’s possible to buy a space suit and go out on a Spacewalk! You’ll float in zero gravity between asteroids to search and collect different minerals and gems that could be useful to craft and boost your production. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/fb117f53438ac09a13066ff7d3300d2550792686.gif[/img]

There’s another feature we’re very excited about that’s the Player’s House! You’ll be able to spend your Kredits to have your own place, and then buy furnitures and decorations for it. You can check it out in the Space Station shops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/ad19b70be41f101df5134c3b831eac45c7367f3d.gif[/img]

Another thing is that you have the option to sleep in your bed. While sleeping the game goes into an “idle mode”, and depending on the Comfort Level of your house, your production gets a small bonus. It’s a good choice if you want to let the game run a bit and come back to play again later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/c1b8630dbc37fc7fa8263f9fb7d00a11dcb17c02.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Radar Screen[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/e5bfe60b0e26c50271bc880ec859f25268a7c3cd.gif[/img]
[i]An upgrade to the Radar Screen look![/i]

[h3][b]Participation in PAX East 2023[/b][/h3]

Lastly, we are thrilled to announce that we will be participating in PAX East 2023, where we will unveil a new trailer featuring updated content.

That's all for now, folks!
But stay tuned for more updates and news :)

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @ BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #4: New and updated Content
notes.content:
Hey, folks!

We know that there were no news about development progress from us since the last Dev Log released in October so we prepared for you much more interesting things for this time 🙂

Let’s drop the veil of secrecy and look at what we are working on!

[h3][b]New buildings and mega buildings[/b][/h3]

[b]Industrial Revolution in Nova Lands![/b]

Let’s start from Mega Buildings: mega furnace and mega electric furnace. Yeah, you heard right – they’re bigger and can produce many times more than the advanced ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/16d0672e1e7d81609f0c36d19eea45e00da0c4ff.gif[/img]
[i]Mega Furnace[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/95d01384fce833d9bce49abc446dcb8366358730.gif[/img]
[i]Mega Electric Furnace[/i]

But what cost, you ask? Well, you’ll need energy for the electric furnace and another new building – the [b]Packager[/b] to [b]pack[/b] resources into the [b]packages[/b]. Let’s see how it works!

[b]Extract more and…pack![/b]

No free space for minerals? Build the Packager and it will load all your items in the special container so you will get some free space in your deposit areas. And, of course, now you can use the packaged items in the Mega Furnaces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/a9c1f80b3ae3e45aa5376ae352e128e56ab3fff6.gif[/img]

[b]It’s time for interplanetary trading![/b]

It seems your industry is growing up so it’s time to sell some resources to outer space. Especially for this we made an Export Rocket! To start you’ll need just to fill rockets with fuel and ask logistics bots to prepare some cargo for shipping to outer space. For that you’ll be paid credits – new in-game currency that will be useful for some new content we want to introduce you…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/7bb73c9e6e4e005e10831fa7c07396de8b2a80d6.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Closer to the Stars![/b][/h3]

And for the final part we put the cherry on top of the cake showing you the new location for Nova Lands. It consists of shops with unique items, new NPCs and new quests. As the Space Station is located in Space you will need a special transport to reach it. And we made it – the Spaceship. With it you will be available to make your travel possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/bcca5d9cd155633e581daa6ab1d78e205acb892d.gif[/img]

[b]Space Station[/b]

On the Space Station as we said you will have the opportunity to visit new shops, buy upgrades and meet some friendly NPCs and quest-givers. However, firstly you’ll need to unlock the shop to open it and use it for your purposes. Let’s have a look at some of the available rooms on the Space Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/6cfd334df7bcf1823f8660a0d09fa5ba524ab1d5.png[/img]
[i]Commander’s Room – place where you’ll unlock shops, upgrades and get quests[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/3aec162511db0c201c8efb07815093f6b7cc59da.jpg[/img]
[i]Skins Shop for those who love to change skins for your character[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d853815b6cb79e75c4b6ae19aa153c6f0d66c7f9.jpg[/img]
[i]One of the closed shops – you’ll need some credits to unlock it[/i]

That’s all for the Space Station for now. We hope you enjoyed it 🙂

[h3][b]Updated portrait[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/ecd8c914cffc0156de117186c19dfff1a3d158f7.gif[/img]
[i]Emilia[/i]

That's all for now, dear friends. We hope that you did like the content we’re preparing for you in Nova Lands. Stay tuned for more news & updates!

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @ BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #2: Eye candy, even more eye candy, and a new publisher!
notes.content:
Hey guys, we hope you’re all doing well!

While the work the everything else continues as planned, we’d like to show your progress on the visuals! The idea is to make the world more alive and vibrant. See for yourself if that worked :)

[h2][b]Designing new tiles[/b][/h2]

First on the list was a texture for each biome to offset plain and flat colors we had before, in various shapes and forms:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/83674a3570c6ab1ad856687cf67931a5156e9561.png[/img]

Then, we made a tileset going on top of the texture for color variations to truly fill the landscapes of Nova with color:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/5e84817f34c0c16a789327200f56395cc8ee5664.png[/img]

To give the decorations more character, various flowers, rocks, and grass types are mixed into the tiles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/8334a793670361c8ec1bc07f065bac48df28aada.gif[/img]

In the end, we’ve got a number of tiles crafted for each island type, each looking much more natural to its biome, instead of randomly scattered elements:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/8af73081a8a8f66bc388bdbde2f514f69310e72e.png[/img]

[h2][b]New tiles in motion[/b][/h2]

The last step is to put it all in motion. We won’t spend words covering that, just take a look for yourself!

[b][i]Grasslands[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/0a1e23814bb9318d7084a63907560ae218d16af4.gif[/img]

[b][i]Snow Island[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/04d29d810f9734e53506ea83bf7696b1c9de97ef.gif[/img]

[b][i]Forest Island[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/45819a2e5d782ff5a9d965eefa575f864d3f6ab0.gif[/img]

[b][i]Desert Island[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/65a666f8bd5b99f12f0acb62c0b429446459462e.gif[/img]

[b][i]Purple Island[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/726c98cdceed57e410ef2f9fc57a3e0a98efd89f.gif[/img]

[b][i]Rock Island (groovy!)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/4a04f4d2a8bda28fc2d45ac13ba43af356fbe98c.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Signing up with HypeTrain Digital[/b][/h2]

This sure was a tough decision to make, as we were approached by a whole number of publishers, all offering to take up Nova Lands and help our game become even better and more well-known. 

We’ve decided that HypeTrain Digital is just the right fit, as they have a ton of experience with releasing indie titles all over the world. It’s not your soulless triple-A publisher, and just to assure you guys, our development roadmap is not affected in any way by signing up with HypeTrain Digital. They will be helping us with marketing, translations, platforms, and many other things, all the while we focus on the game itself—so that you can start playing the full release sooner! 

[h2][b]Participation in PAX West[/b][/h2]

That's not all! Nova Lands will also participate in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/paxwest2022]PAX West 2022[/url], which begins today! What's more, you'll be able to see our brand new trailer and some more (secret!) stuff on the main PAX stream, on the 3rd of September, 12 pm PT. 

And that’s all for now! Hope you enjoyed looking at what’s to come in Nova Lands, and more news coming soon!

Ed, Douglas, and Lucas @ BEHEMUTT

notes.title: SPEED RUN STEAM KEYS GIVEAWAY!
notes.content:
[h1]To spice things up in our community we're kicking a speedrun challenge![/h1]

[h3]ːsummer2019flagː 1 Steam Key (beta access & full release) for the fastest time[/h3]
[h3]ːsummer2019boostː 1 Steam Key (beta access & full release) randomly drawn from everybody that entered the challenge[/h3]

How to participate:
[list]
[*] Record your gameplay from start to finish with zero editing
[*] The whole game screen must be shown, especially the timer
[*] The time we will count is [b]WHEN THE FIRST STEEL ITEM PRODUCED BY AN ELECTRIC FURNACE APPEARS ON SCREEN[/b]
[*] Post that recording on YouTube (it can be kept public or unlisted)
[*] Post the link to your recording on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/EAgPVJNsdZ]Discord server[/url]
[/list]

Rules:
[olist]
    [*]Rules can change anytime in case we forget about something
    [*]If any bug exploits are used on the gameplay, we have the final say whether that bug is allowed or not
    [*]Update the game to the newest version so it shows the speedrun timer
    [*]The submissions will close at 10 pm (GMT) Monday 21/02/2022
    [*]Please be kind to others and let's have fun
[/olist]

The results will be posted as soon as possible after the end of the challenge.
Good luck everybody! ːgoblattː

notes.title: The Supercomputer Update
notes.content:
We're running a Closed Alpha on Steam!
The game has just been updated and we're sending alpha keys for players interested in testing the game.

How to join the Closed Alpha?
Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/EAgPVJNsdZ]DISCORD[/url] and fill out the form on the [b]#steam-alpha-access[/b] channel.

Come hang with us, ask questions and leave suggestions!
[url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ][img]https://i.imgur.com/FHrGkGB.png[/img][/url]

About the update:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5uA2nfu.png[/img]

[h2]The Collection Screen[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvFGsZH.png[/img]
This screen is meant to give you an overall of your progress in the game.

Also, notice 2 new features in the game: Badges and Relics. Badges are kinda like trophies for achieving big milestones in the game. Relics are rewards for challenges that grant you a special perk. 

[h2]Advanced Farms[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GS3iNHY.gif[/img]
A game-changer and the biggest building yet!
They work like simple farm plots but they have their own extractor and watering system. You provide the seeds, water, and fertilizers. They do the work. Automatized agriculture to step up production!

[h2]Oxygen Link[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MkD5chg.png[/img]
A most requested building, the Oxygen Link. Take oxygen from the Oxygenator to adjacent islands. Finally!

[h2]Production Expansion[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0xsOsd.png[/img]
The main focus of this update is expanding production and technology. That means more items, more researches, more buildings, more recipes. 

The Assembler building has a new visual (pic). Also, it is now a bit smaller and occupies the same area as a Refinery or an Advanced Furnace.


Once again thanks for sticking with us.

We hope you love it!

notes.title: Alpha Access - A chance to test the game!
notes.content:
We started a Closed Alpha phase on Steam!
The game has just been updated and we're sending alpha keys for players interested in testing the game.

How to join the Alpha Access?
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ]DISCORD[/url] and fill out the form on the #steam-alpha-access channel.

Come hang with us, ask questions and leave suggestions!
[url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ][img]https://i.imgur.com/FHrGkGB.png[/img][/url]

About the update:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2E80YqY.png[/img]
[h2]The Encampment Island[/h2]
We added a sort of 'Encampment Island' where other members of the crew (NPCs) will help you and ask for your help. And yes, that means a lot of things to unlock and upgrade!

[h2]The Skins System[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gQibGmF.gif[/img]
Character personalization! You can finally choose how you look.
A few skins come unlocked from start, others have a cost or a quest necessary to unlock them.

[h2]The Islands Screen[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OjwYlvP.png[/img]
It starts as a simple map showing the islands you've unlocked, but soon enough it'll be an overview of your production flow in its entirety. What's being produced, what's being moved between islands, what are bots collecting on each island.

[h2]The Museum & Laboratory[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5iBZFPy.png[/img]
Somebody was supposed to be helping him to complete his collection. Apparently he's now doing all the work by himself. This guy could use your help!

[h2]The Player Screen[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kObjzAs.png[/img]
It shows the progress of the player with their personal belongings.
Tons of upgrades to invest in and cool new icons, amiright??

[h2]A Brand New Boss![/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9YmHXpO.gif[/img]
It features a Combat encounter, and a Pacific encounter, just like Moschillar.
We worked hard on it and I hope you'll love it.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ARy52N3.png[/img]
From this update onwards, the game will be fully playable on a Controller too!

We expect some minor bugs or weird behaviors in the beginning. As always, you can help us reporting anything wrong you see. We'd love to hear your opinion.

[h2]New Animations[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c7Pcvw1.gif[/img]
And my personal favorite addition in this update: creatures now have eating animation! :sob:

As you can see, we're working hard on the game, adding exciting features and new content. We really hope you like it and we'd love to hear what you think!

Cheers,
Ed & Doug from BEHEMUTT
